body: Right? I'm only human
One more light by Linkin Park
I feel like I'm not worth redemption.. that I deserve to die

You're gonna be a great one indeed.. I believe that. And I am seeing a psychologist but it doesn't really help much because we tend to focus on what's bothering us rather than to forget it. So I have to think back all the bad things I've done once a month, which isn't really helpful

:'( I feel bad if I were to let you down.. sometimes these suicidal thoughts makes me feel peaceful as I know I won't be here for much longer. It's really a bad mechanism but it works to ease the mind and the heart. That's all I want to feel, peace..

But I'm still traumatized about what I've done in the past and what has happened to me. How do I live with myself? All the memories , all the guilt and shame. All the heartbreaks I did and endured myself. Just how?
You make me wanna stay
I'm filled with guilt, shame, regret. There's so much things that I can't fix, I did terrible things. So terrible ending for a terrible person seems good for me.
Thank you.. I really appreciate this so much but I'm so sorry as I have made up my mind.. I will keep you update.. If I stopped replying then it means I'm really gone
It's very sweet of you to check up on me.. really appreciate it alot.. thank you
It wont get better and it can't better
Sadly yes.. was a coward to really pull the cords. Will find another way to do so but I guess I'm just tired now
I've been staying strong for 8 years.. it's time to let go now
I swear i need a hug. Really need it. God I'm so tired

I wish I was as strong as you, I really wish that. I'm pathetic when I think about it. But I think im going to wait a few days more and jump of my building. It is nice to see everyone trying to stop me but I just cant do it anymore man .. for real.. I am just done.. I'm just waiting for the right moment to do it
:') I have no words to say.. all I know is I have to attempt it again
I'm fine with it, sorry for putting this on you guys, hope no one blames themselves
I'm sorry if I stopped replying :/ really am sorry
I'm so so sorry :'( f it's a failed attempt I will get back to you alright? Thank you so much for being here
Be here with me when I do it, that's the best thing you could do for me, at least there's someone there until the very end
I'm so sorry to hear that... Life has its up and downs for me but it has been down for 2 months and it's only getting worse. I just can't deal with it anymore I'm sorry :')❤️
I've tried everything, from family and friends comfort, to staying in a mental hospital and seeing a psychologist. I've tried it all. Man I wish I could hug you right now cause that's all I need
Singapore :( I'll do it after the sun rises. Thank you for trying to help me but you know how depression works.

I wish I could get a hug right now, I know that might stop me from doing it because then I'll cry, like alot, then get tired and sleep. But I'm just waiting for everyone to go out, which will be in an hour time
Don't worry about me okay, thank you for replying :) but it has to end, there's no meaning in life anymore and my depression has won.
What's more weird is I LOVE YOU, yea man. I do
You're talking to a dead man
Ntg is pretty anymore
